theme.label: Theme
theme.settingsHint: Choose how StockPilot looks. "System" follows your operating system's light or dark setting.

dashboard.heading: Best stocks today
dashboard.headingInfo: Companies ranked across the trading methods you select. Each method scores every stock 0–100 and flags whether its setup fired recently; the Combined column is the average across your chosen methods. Pick methods with the Methods button.
dashboard.subtitle: Multi-method ranking across the GPW after the latest close.
dashboard.emptyNoMatch: No stocks match your search or filters.
dashboard.combinedInfo: Average of the scores from the methods you've selected (0–100). Ranks companies highest across all the chosen methods together.

weekly.label: 1W
weekly.confirmsInfo: Weekly VSA agrees with the daily signal — the weekly chart reads {{verdict}} ({{rating}}/100). Higher-timeframe confirmation.
weekly.conflictsInfo: Weekly VSA contradicts the daily signal — the weekly chart reads {{verdict}} ({{rating}}/100). Treat the daily call with caution.
weekly.filterInfo: Only stocks whose weekly VSA verdict leans the same way as the daily one (both bullish, or both bearish). Weekly candles are the stored daily bars resampled to weeks and run through the same VSA engine.
weekly.columnInfo: The same VSA engine run on weekly candles. Blank when the stock has under ~30 weeks of stored history.

chart.intervalHint: Bar size: 30m, 1H and 4H are intraday; 1D and 1W are end-of-day
chart.intradayNote: Intraday {{interval}} candles are fetched live and reach back to {{from}}; the rating above and the trading-method overlays stay on daily bars.
chart.timeRangeHint: Scroll or zoom the chart to change the range automatically

strength.title: Market strength
strength.info: Bullish VSA patterns detected for this stock in the shown period, with the date each last fired. ✓ = detected, ✕ = not present. Spring = trapped sellers below support; Successful Test = quiet retest of lows; SOS = strong buying bar.

weakness.title: Market weakness
weakness.info: Bearish VSA patterns detected for this stock. Upthrust = trapped buyers above resistance; No Demand = quiet up-bar without professional interest; SOW = strong selling bar.

detection.title: Adjust context for signal-detection sensitivity
detection.info: Filters which VSA signals appear on the chart and in the Strength / Weakness checklist. Sensitivity: higher reveals more (and weaker) signals; lower shows only the strongest. Context window: only signals from the last N trading sessions are shown.

fundamentals.title: Fundamentals
fundamentals.info: Company fundamentals from Yahoo Finance, refreshed daily. Market cap = market value of all shares; P/E = price divided by yearly earnings per share (lower can mean cheaper); EPS = earnings per share; Dividend yield = yearly dividend as % of the price.
fundamentals.priceReturnInfo: How much the share price alone moved over each period, measured from this stock's own stored price history. Dividends are NOT included, so for a high-yielding stock your actual return was higher. “—” means the stored history doesn't reach back that far yet.
fundamentals.incomeInfo: Revenue and profit over the last four reported quarters (trailing 12 months). ROE = profit earned per zloty of shareholder capital; ROA = profit per zloty of assets — higher generally means a more efficient business. “—” means the figure was not reported.
fundamentals.investmentInfo: Money the company spends on its own business — factories, machines, buildings, software. “% of revenue” shows how capital-intensive it is; “% of cash flow” above 100% means it invests more than the business itself generates, so the rest comes from reserves or debt. Compare companies on the Investment page.
fundamentals.noInvestmentData: No investment data reported for this company.

rating.title: VSA Rating
rating.info: 0–100 score built from all detected VSA signals with time decay: recent signals count more, old ones fade out (half impact after ~30 days). Above 70 = strong accumulation (green), around 50 = neutral, below 30 = distribution (red).

methods.toggle: Show or hide {{name}} markers on the chart

volume.title: Volume (RVOL)
volume.info: Relative volume: how heavy this stock's recent trading is versus its own normal. It divides the average volume of the last few sessions by the average of the sessions before them. 1.0× = normal activity; ~1.5–2× is elevated and ~3×+ is extreme — a sign of unusual professional interest. Same measure as the Volume surge page.
volume.noData: Not enough history to measure volume yet.

summary.title: Analytics summary
summary.info: The bottom line: StockPilot's separate opinions — the VSA verdict, the AI Insight second opinion, the Signal Trust Score and every trading method — pulled together into one read. The stance is the consolidated direction; 'agreement' is how strongly the signals line up (100 = unanimous, 50 = evenly split). Computed locally on the server; deterministic and free.
summary.disclaimer: {{engine}} · as of {{asOf}} · a summary of historical data, not investment advice

methods.title: Choose which trading methods to show as columns
methods.heading: Trading methods

refresh.title: Download fresh data from Yahoo Finance and recalculate all VSA ratings. Data updates automatically once a day after the GPW close (18:00).
